home.subtitle: Modern frontend template configured with React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, Zustand and TanStack Query.

login.title: Sign In
login.subtitle: Enter your username and master password
login.totpSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app

recovery.title: Recover access
recovery.subtitle: Use your recovery key to set a new master password
recovery.success: Master password reset. Sign in with the new one.

errors.generic: Could not reset. Check your details.

newKey.title: New recovery key
newKey.warning: Your previous key is no longer valid. Store this NEW key somewhere safe: it is the only way to recover your vault if you forget your master password.
newKey.confirm: I have saved my new recovery key in a safe place.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
totp.description: Add a code from your phone when signing in. Protects your account even if someone has your password.
totp.scan: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, Authy or similar.
totp.disableHint: Enter a current code to disable 2FA.

passkey.title: Passkey unlock
passkey.description: Unlock the vault with your device (fingerprint, face or PIN/Windows Hello), without typing the master password. The master password is still required on new devices.
passkey.unsupported: Your browser or device does not support passkeys.
passkey.needUnlock: Unlock the vault first (go to My vault and enter your master password).
passkey.noPrf: Your device does not support the PRF extension required for this.
passkey.help: Each device registers its own passkey and verifies it however it can (fingerprint, face, PIN or Windows password). On Windows, if it only offers a QR to scan, it's because Windows Hello doesn't support the required extension in this browser; use your phone or your master password instead.

autolock.title: Auto-lock
autolock.description: The vault locks itself after this idle time and when you reload the page. You'll need to enter your master password again.
autolock.label: Lock after

startpage.title: Start page
startpage.description: When you sign in, open this page directly.
startpage.label: Open at

master.title: Change master password
master.description: Change your master password without losing the vault. The internal key is re-wrapped; contents stay the same.
master.needUnlock: Unlock the vault first (go to My vault and enter your master password).
master.error: Could not change the master password.

backup.title: Backup (export / import)
backup.description: Your vault lives only on the server. Export a copy you control, or import from another manager.
backup.needUnlock: Unlock the vault first to export or import.
backup.exportHint: Generates an encrypted .json file with the password you choose. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup.exportPwShort: Use at least 6 characters for the file.
backup.importHint: Accepts your encrypted backup (.json) or a Chrome/Bitwarden CSV. Items are added to the vault.
backup.importPw: File password (if it is an encrypted backup)
backup.importPwNeeded: This backup is encrypted: enter its password.
backup.importError: Could not import. Check the file or the password.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices where your session is open. Close any you do not recognize.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Your master password encrypts your whole vault
register.masterHint: Your master password is never sent to the server and CANNOT be recovered. If you forget it, only your recovery key can open your vault. Choose something strong and memorable.
register.genericError: Could not create the account. Please try again.

strength.weak: Weak — use more characters and variety.

errors.usernameShort: Username must be at least 3 characters.
errors.usernameInvalid: Only letters, numbers and underscore are allowed.
errors.passwordShort: Master password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordWeak: Master password too weak. Use a long passphrase (4+ words) or mix uppercase, numbers and symbols.

recovery.title: Save your recovery key
recovery.warning: This is the ONLY way to recover your vault if you forget your master password. It is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe and offline.
recovery.confirm: I saved my recovery key in a safe place.

unlock.title: Vault locked
unlock.subtitle: Enter your master password to unlock
unlock.passkeyError: Could not unlock with the passkey. Use your master password.

vault.title: My vault
vault.subtitle: Your passwords, end-to-end encrypted
vault.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, username or site...
vault.empty: Your vault is empty. Add your first password.
vault.deleteConfirmText: Are you sure you want to delete "{{title}}"? This action cannot be undone.

card.luhnWarning: This number fails the checksum. Double-check the digits.
card.pinNotice: The PIN is encrypted like everything else. It is never shown by default.
card.styleNotice: Pick how your card looks. The app cannot read the real design: system wallets get it from your bank through the card network, and making that lookup would expose your card to a third party.
card.issuerDetected: Issuer detected from the BIN, locally
card.issuerSource: Community data (CC-BY-4.0). The BIN never leaves your device.

dashboard.demoIntro: This modal demonstrates the fixes: close with the Escape key, click outside to close, and background scroll lock. Scroll to the bottom: the content behind does NOT move.
dashboard.demoLine: Filler line {{n}} to force inner scrolling.

loader.connectError: We couldn't connect to the server after several attempts.
loader.webError: There was a problem loading the web service.
loader.tryAgainHint: Please reload the page or try again later.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or was moved.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: An unexpected error occurred. Try reloading the page.
